name: Default
shortDescription: Usenet binary newsreader that downloads, verifies, repairs and extracts NZB downloads automatically, managed from a web interface.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated SABNZBD_PASSWORD from the environment settings. It is written only on first start, so change it later in Config > General. The first-run wizard asks for your Usenet provider's server, username and password, which you need an account for.
